copy.hero_headline: Scale your mental health network without scaling credentialing chaos
copy.subheadline: Headway connects patients to thousands of mental health providers across states. CertifyOS automates the credentialing, licensing, and enrollment that stands between you and faster growth.
copy.value_prop_one_liner: Purpose-built infrastructure for digital health companies managing multi-state provider networks and multi-plan enrollment at scale.
copy.pain_paragraph: You're onboarding independent therapists and psychiatrists across major markets—New York, LA, Chicago, SF, Houston. Each new provider means credentialing with dozens of health plans, tracking licenses in multiple states, and managing virtual care compliance. Your 700-person team is growing fast, but credentialing remains slow and manual. It delays provider launch, blocks network expansion, and pulls your ops team away from higher-impact work.
